note: The start of the opinion, where recent CourtListener opinions have the caption and the panel (it is not kept in the table)

name: caption

name: caption
note: Otherwise, the caption in the opinion's opening: a role before "v." (such as "Plaintiff-Appellee, v."), with only punctuation, docket numbers, or capital letters between them, through the other party's role if it is near; or a first party in capital letters and a role after the second (as the Third Circuit writes them)

name: panel_text

name: panel_text

name: panel_judges
